evidence_summary: PKP2 is a desmosomal plaque component that interacts with DSP and JUP; DSP 1-584 is annotated as the JUP/PKP2 interaction region.
support_sources: UniProt Q99959; UniProt P15924 region 1-584; UniProt P14923; PubMed 11790773; 22781308; 16917092; local AF3_PILOTV2_020
caveat: Reduced plaque model omits DSG2/DSC2 transmembrane/cadherin context and intermediate filaments.

evidence_summary: PKP2-JUP interaction is directly annotated in both PKP2/JUP UniProt entries and is central to desmosomal plaque organization.
caveat: Pair-only job may miss DSP scaffold context but gives a cleaner PKP2/JUP interface.

evidence_summary: DSP interacts with PKP2, and DSP N-terminal 1-584 is annotated as interaction with JUP and PKP2.
support_sources: UniProt Q99959; UniProt P15924; PubMed 11790773; 22781308; IntAct EBI-10764564/EBI-10764568; PubMed 25225338
caveat: Uses only DSP N-terminus; full DSP is too large and adds unrelated C-terminal filament-binding burden.

evidence_summary: PKP2 interacts with DSC2 and DSG2, but cadherin tail boundaries and membrane/desmosome assembly context need separate review.
caveat: Hold until DSG2/DSC2 gene packets; avoid overloading PKP2 top-3.

evidence_summary: UniProt notes PKP2 interaction with SCN5A, ANK3, and GJA1 by similarity; biologically interesting for arrhythmia but not enough for first-pass AF3.
caveat: Needs targeted literature and boundaries; do not use as publication-ready AF3 partner yet.

evidence_summary: PKP2 has keratin/VIM interaction evidence, but DSP is the more cardiac/desmosome-plaque relevant first-pass partner.
caveat: May be more epithelial than cardiomyocyte-specific; hold for sensitivity.

evidence_summary: IntAct contains many high-throughput or broad signaling hits such as 14-3-3 proteins, EGFR, CFTR, and others.
caveat: Exclude from default AF3 to prevent noisy non-cardiac interaction features.
